title: The 3 Best Strollers for Twins
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for strollers for twins, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at strollers for twins using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Baby Jogger City Mini GT2 Double Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Side-by-side double seating, Forever-air rubber tires, never go flat, All-wheel suspension.
strengths: Side-by-side layout gives both twins equal, identical seating, the preferred setup for most twin parents
All-wheel suspension handles sidewalks and light off-road terrain smoothly for two riders
Compatible with multiple infant car seat brands, not locked into one manufacturer's ecosystem
Auto-lock fold is fast to operate solo, even loaded with two children's gear
limitations: 29 to 31 inches wide, doesn't fit through every standard interior doorway
Heavier and bulkier to lift into a trunk than a tandem double
features: Forever-air rubber tires, never go flat
Compatible with Britax, Cybex, Graco, and Maxi Cosi infant car seats

products.name: Graco Ready2Grow LX 2.0 Double Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Tandem front-to-back double seating, Accepts two compatible Graco infant car seats, Rear seat converts to bench seat or standing platform.
strengths: Narrower tandem footprint fits standard doorways that side-by-side doubles can't clear
Accepts two infant car seats at once, a genuine newborn-twin feature
Folds down to roughly single-stroller size, easier to fit in smaller trunks
limitations: Rear seat sits lower and more enclosed than the front seat, an unequal view between the two children
Not as smooth over rough terrain as suspension-focused all-terrain doubles
Bench/standing conversion is more useful for siblings than same-age twins
features: Accepts two compatible Graco infant car seats
Rear seat converts to bench seat or standing platform
Folds like a single stroller despite the tandem layout

products.name: Baby Trend Sit N' Stand Double 2.0 Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Front and rear seats plus a rear standing platform, 5-point safety harness on both seats, Parent console with cup holders and phone holder.
strengths: Two full seats plus a standing platform option gives flexibility as twins grow at different paces
5-point harnesses on both seats meet the same safety standard as pricier doubles
Parent console is a genuinely useful everyday convenience
limitations: Ride quality and suspension are noticeably more basic than the City Mini GT2 or Ready2Grow
Bulkier fold than the tandem-style Ready2Grow
Front and rear seats aren't identical, one twin rides slightly differently than the other
features: Front and rear seats plus a rear standing platform
Parent console with cup holders and phone holder
Compatible with EZ-Lift infant car seat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
